# transcribe.cpp 0.1.3

`TranscribeCpp.xcframework` is the unmodified upstream release framework from:
https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/releases/tag/v0.1.3

Download: https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/releases/download/v0.1.3/TranscribeCpp.xcframework.zip
Archive SHA-256: `b7a3442e2f3552cac1ee71b5e164934dd4db243f6b4b16b1e3e3ed5d1645eefd`

This version matches Hex's `transcribe-cpp = "=0.1.3"` dependency. The Swift package consumes the macOS framework; the app build script embeds and signs it. Upstream MIT and ggml license notices are included inside the XCFramework.
